|● Open an issue about the build.
|
|╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
|│ Create issue                                             │
|│ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
|│ ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮ │
|│ │ {                                                    │ │
|│ │ "title": "Fix build"                                 │ │
|│ │ }                                                    │ │
|│ ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯ │
|│                                                          │
|│ Do you want to use this tool?                            │
|│                                                          │
|│ ❯ 1. Yes                                                 │
|│   2. Yes, and approve tool "Create issue" from server    │
|│   "github" for the rest of the running session           │
|│   3. Yes, and approve all tools from server "github" for │
|│   the rest of the running session                        │
|│   4. No, and tell Copilot what to do differently (Esc to │
|│   stop)                                                  │
|│                                                          │
|│ ↑/↓ to navigate · enter to select · esc to cancel        │
|╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
